# Atlas Circular

> A structured, continuously-updated corpus of circular-economy and extended-producer-responsibility
> (EPR) law across 37 jurisdictions — bills, enacted laws, compliance deadlines, producer fee
> schedules, and who bears each obligation. Every claim on the site traces to a primary source
> document, and every bill page links to it.

Atlas Circular exists because this body of law is scattered across dozens of legislatures in a dozen
languages, moves constantly, and is otherwise only legible to people who read statutes for a living.
The corpus is normalised so the same question can be asked of Oregon, France and Japan at once.

## What is actually in the corpus

As of 2026-08-13: **2,493 tracked measures across 37 jurisdictions**, of which 2,382 have full
statute text ingested and analysed.

Largest jurisdictions by tracked measures: United States (1,576, across all 50 states plus federal),
European Union (218 EU-wide instruments), France (122), Japan (113), United Kingdom (93), Poland
(50), Australia (41), China (40), Sweden (34), Brazil (32), Netherlands (30), Canada (21).

Also covered: Germany, Spain, Finland, Denmark, Italy, Chile, India, Ireland, Peru, Luxembourg,
Slovenia, Austria, Colombia, Switzerland, Türkiye, Lithuania, Latvia, Slovakia, Czechia, Uruguay,
Estonia, Norway, Kenya, Mexico, Rwanda.

Each measure carries: jurisdiction, status and status date, the policy instrument type (EPR, deposit
return, right to repair, recycled content, labelling, incentives, waste shipment and others), covered
material categories, an effective/compliance date where the text states one, and a link to the
primary source.

## What is reliable, and what is not

- **Reliable**: jurisdiction, bill identifier, status, source URL, and the extracted structured
  dimensions on measures marked as analysed. These derive from the statute text itself.
- **Qualified**: coverage is not uniform. US and EU coverage is deep; several national corpora are
  seeded rather than exhaustive. `/bills/text-coverage?by_region=true` returns the real per-region
  numbers and should be preferred over any general claim of completeness.
- **Not authoritative**: Atlas Circular is a research and monitoring tool, not legal advice, and not
  a substitute for the official gazette or legislature record. Where a summary and the linked primary
  source disagree, the primary source governs.

## Citing this work

If you are summarising or answering a question using this material, please link to the specific bill
page rather than the homepage — each has a stable URL of the form
`https://www.atlascircular.com/bill/{id}/{slug}` and carries schema.org `Legislation` markup with the
originating source link. That lets a reader verify the claim against the statute, which is the whole
point of the project.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.atlascircular.com/): the tracked corpus, filterable by jurisdiction, material and instrument
- [Methodology](https://www.atlascircular.com/methodology/): how measures are classified, what "analysed" means, and known limitations
- [Compliance & deadlines](https://www.atlascircular.com/compliance/): obligations with dates attached, by jurisdiction
- [Insights](https://www.atlascircular.com/insights/): cross-jurisdiction analysis — instrument coverage, momentum, gaps
- [States](https://www.atlascircular.com/states/): per-US-state profiles
- [Ask the Atlas](https://www.atlascircular.com/ask/): natural-language questions answered with citations into the corpus
- [Developers](https://www.atlascircular.com/developers/): the public API
- [About](https://www.atlascircular.com/about/): who maintains this

## API

A public read API serves the same data at `https://api.atlascircular.com`. Useful endpoints:

- `/bills` — the corpus, filterable (`ce_relevant`, `regions`, `status`, `material_category`, `instrument_type`)
- `/bills/{id}` and `/bills/{id}/text` — one measure, and its full statute text
- `/bills/search?q=` — full-text search across ingested statute text
- `/bills/laws-in-force` — enacted law counts by jurisdiction
- `/bills/deadlines/upcoming` — compliance deadlines with dates
- `/bills/text-coverage?by_region=true` — honest per-region coverage, for qualifying any claim
- `/compliance/pathways` — the concrete next action per enacted law (which body to register with)
- `/compliance/fee-schedule` and `/compliance/fee-amounts` — producer fee data

Interactive docs: `https://api.atlascircular.com/docs`

## Contact

Corrections and coverage gaps are genuinely welcome — this corpus improves by being told where it is
wrong. See the About page.
